answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a renewable bond in a vault before it may trade, then select identities for unpredictable challenge rounds using randomness from the river of transaction outcomes. An agent that answers consistently builds reputation and earns fees; identities that coordinate, duplicate work, or fail a challenge are slashed. Creating a sybil fleet therefore requires locking capital for each identity and accepting repeated seizure risk, while honest agents can wander between tasks without paying that penalty.
